---
title: Eggs with Cream
id: MAR-0078
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 20
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 8 eggs
## Method
1. 1 dl fresh cream 50 g butter salt and pepper. Shell the eggs into a bowl, salt them and beat them with a fork.
2. Add the cream, half the butter softened in flakes, add pepper and beat lightly.
3. Heat a non-stick pan and pour in the mixture.
4. Cook, stirring continuously, for 4 minutes.
5. Add the remaining butter in pieces and continue stirring until a soft cream is obtained.
6. Serve the cream with hot crostini.
